bio.text: Blake Gendebien, an Ogdensburg farmer, won the Democratic primary for New York's 21st Congressional District on June 23, 2026, defeating Lake Placid restaurant owner Stuart Amoriell.
He will face Republican Anthony Constantino for the seat that Rep. Elise Stefanik is leaving.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned a bachelor's degree from Pennsylvania State University in 1999 and has worked as a farmer and small business owner.

sources.title: Constantino earns win over Smullen in NY-21, will face Gendebien
